data.one_liner: Provides an emoji keyboard widget and quick emoji popup for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides an emoji keyboard widget containing emojis up to unicode 16.0 divided into categories, a recent tab, search functionality, skin tone selection via long press, and a quick emoji popup widget for reactions.
use_when: You want to allow users to type exclusively with emojis.
You need an emoji picker or keyboard layout for chat message reactions.
avoid_when: You need a standard alphanumeric software keyboard.
You want a fully native OS emoji keyboard instead of an in-app widget.
strengths: Supports emojis up to unicode 16.0 across categories with a recent emojis tab.
Includes skin tone selection via long press and search capabilities.
Comes with a secondary quick emoji popup widget for chat reactions.
weaknesses: Limited to emojis and cannot be used as a general-purpose text keyboard.
data.minimal_example:
EmojiKeyboard(
  emojiController: controller,
  onEmojiChanged: (emoji) {},
  showEmojiKeyboard: true,
)
